answers.name: Robert Smalls
answers.note: Born into slavery, he escaped in 1862 by commandeering the Confederate ship Planter and later served in the House.

questions.prompt: Name a member of Congress who received the Medal of Honor

answers.name: Daniel Sickles
answers.note: He was acquitted of murder in 1859 and received the Medal of Honor for his role at Gettysburg, where he lost a leg.

questions.prompt: Name a member of Congress who also served as lieutenant governor of a state

questions.prompt: Name a member of Congress who also served in a presidential Cabinet
